interview.name: Vik
interview.answer: The repair drive time and location aren’t specified in the notes.

reflections: Vik is coordinating a repair drive and is the main point of contact for timing and logistics.
Nell is willing to help spread information, but she is currently waiting on clearer details from Vik.
Dane is ready to contribute practical labor and responds well to concrete tasks and direction.
Vik is coordinating the repair drive and acting as the main information hub for timing and logistics.
Dane, Eli, and Jules are willing to help in practical ways, and each is waiting on clear timing or instructions before committing fully.
The group responds well to concise, direct updates and seems organized around a shared, flexible plan rather than a fixed schedule.
Vik is coordinating a group effort and relies on others to help spread updates and bring supplies.
The others are cooperative and flexible, repeatedly confirming they will be ready once the time is set.
Rey is focused on planning efficiency and wants the list ready so the quickest fixes can be sorted first.
Vik is coordinating a group effort and tends to keep everyone updated once timing is confirmed.
Bo is willing to help with the garage work and prefers to wait for the final time before heading over.
Rey and Kira are both responsive helpers who are waiting on the start time and are ready to take on specific support tasks once it is set.
Vik is coordinating the group and prefers to share logistics only once details are confirmed.
Rey, Kira, and Uli are responsive and willing to help with practical setup tasks like sorting donations and loading boxes.
Hana is asking for the key event details upfront, suggesting the group needs clearer event information before others can act.

events.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive, and I’ll pass the word along to a few neighbors. What time are we aiming for?
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ve just been hearing second-hand, so I’m not sure yet. If you hear a time, please let me know and I’ll help spread it too.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll ask around and share the time as soon as I hear it.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going? Anything you need me to help with?
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Vik: It’s going well so far — I’m just trying to keep the repair drive organized and on track. If you can help by sorting donations or loading boxes, that’d be a big help.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Dane: Sure thing — I can sort donations and help load boxes. Point me to where you want me to start.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll head over after lunch and help sort the tools.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Vik: Great — after lunch works, and I’ll keep passing the word along as soon as I have the final time.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll stick to the plan and be there after lunch.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Vik: I’m still waiting on the time, but as soon as I hear it I’ll pass it along to you and the neighbors. Thanks for helping spread the word.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll be ready Saturday morning, and I can bring my toolkit, screws, and drill. Just send the time when you have it.
events.speaker: Jules

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Saturday at the front porch.

events.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep everyone posted as soon as the time’s set, and I’ll let the neighbors know you’re bringing tools.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll bring the basics and head to the garage when I can.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Vik: Great, Bo — thanks. I’ll keep everyone posted as soon as I have the final time for the garage.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Bo: Sounds good — just keep me posted on the final time, and I’ll head to the garage when I can.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Rey: I still haven’t heard the start time, but I’m on it. If you get the list ready, I can help sort the quickest fixes first.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Vik: Great, I’ll get the list ready and keep everyone posted as soon as the start time comes in.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep an eye out for the start time and be ready to help sort the list when it’s set.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Vik: Thanks, Kira — I’m still waiting on the final start time, but I’ll keep everyone posted as soon as I have it. If you can help sort donations or load boxes, that’d be a big help.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Kira: Thanks — I’ll wait for the final time before I tell anyone. I can help with donations or boxes once it’s confirmed.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll let you know as soon as the time is confirmed, and then we can get everyone lined up. Donations and boxes will be a huge help.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Vik: I’m still waiting on the final start time, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I have it. If you can help sort donations or load boxes, that’d be a big help.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — I can sort donations and help load boxes once you send the start time.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli — I’ll send the start time as soon as it’s confirmed and keep you posted.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Vik: Still waiting on the final start time, but I’m keeping everyone posted. Once it’s confirmed, I’ll pass it along and we can sort donations and boxes.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — once the start time is confirmed, can you also share the location and what we’re collecting?
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll share the time, location, and what we’re collecting as soon as it’s confirmed.
events.speaker: Vik
